title: Evaluate a reward model and a judge
brief: Measure pairwise accuracy, calibration, position bias, a length-controlled win rate, and Bradley-Terry strengths, including ties.
hints: pairwise_accuracy drops labels of 0. A score tie on a decisive label is a miss, not half a point.
Bin b covers [b/n_bins, (b+1)/n_bins), and the last bin includes 1. Confidence is the mean predicted probability in the bin.
swap_consistency is the fraction of pairs where judge(right, left) equals the negation of judge(left, right). A tie is 0, and 0 equals its negation.
A tie adds half a win to each player. Center the log strengths so they have mean 0.
The length-controlled win rate is the sigmoid of the intercept. Ridge only the length coefficient, by 1e-6, for 20 Newton steps from zeros.
